get.description:
Retrieve a publicly shared artifact by its slug or UUID.

This endpoint is unauthenticated.  It returns the artifact name,
a signed download URL, and file metadata so the public frontend
can render and offer a download button.

post.description:
Create or retrieve Stripe customer and setup billing portal session.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to set up billing for.
request_body : BillingSetupRequest
    Request body with return_url.
user_id : str
    Current user ID from auth.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingSetupResponse]
    Response with portal URL.

Create a subscription for the workspace.

If the workspace hasn't used a trial yet, starts a free trial directly.
If the workspace has already used their trial, returns a Stripe Checkout URL
where they can add a payment method and subscribe.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to create subscription for.
request_body : BillingSubscribeRequest
    Request body with return_url for Checkout redirect.
user_id : str
    Current user ID from auth.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingSubscribeResponse]
    Response with subscription info. If redirect_url is set, redirect user there.

Confirm a Stripe Checkout session and link the subscription.

This endpoint should be called by the frontend after the user completes
Stripe Checkout and is redirected back to the success URL. It retrieves
the subscription from the completed session and links it to the workspace.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID.
request_body : BillingConfirmCheckoutRequest
    Request body with session_id.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingConfirmCheckoutResponse]
    Response with subscription ID and status.

get.description:
Get billing information for a workspace.

This endpoint returns complete billing information including subscription status,
seat counts, billing periods, cancellation info, pricing, estimated charges,
and upcoming invoice data when available.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to get billing info for.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingInfoResponse]
    Response with complete billing data.

post.description:
Handle Stripe webhooks.

Receives webhook events from Stripe for subscription updates, payment
events, and other billing-related notifications.  Signature verification
happens in the ``stripe_event_from_request`` dependency.

Parameters
----------
event : stripe.Event
    Verified Stripe event produced by the ``stripe_event_from_request``
    dependency.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[WebhookResponse]
    Response confirming webhook processing.

get.description:
Preview what will be billed for a workspace.

Useful for testing and understanding upcoming charges.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to preview billing for.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingPreviewResponse]
    Response with billing preview data.

post.description:
Execute testing actions for Stripe billing.

Available actions: end_trial, advance_billing_period, cancel_subscription,
reactivate_subscription, cancel_immediately, simulate_payment_failure,
reset_everything.

Only available in Stripe test mode and non-production environments.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to perform actions on.
request_body : BillingTestRequest
    Request body with action name.
db_session : Session
    Database session.

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[BillingTestResponse]
    Response with action result.

get.description:
Get all dynamic fields for a workspace grouped by SQL hash for promotion.

This endpoint returns dynamic fields grouped by their SQL hash, showing
usage statistics and field details for admin promotion.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID to retrieve promotable fields for
request : Request
    FastAPI request object
current_user_id : str
    ID of the current authenticated user
db_session : Session
    Database session dependency

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[DynamicFieldPromotionListResponseSchema]
    Response containing promotable dynamic fields with usage statistics

post.description:
Promote dynamic fields with the given SQL hash to the data model.

This endpoint finds all dynamic fields with the specified SQL hash, marks them
as promoted, and adds a permanent field definition to the git repository.
Old questions will continue to work with their existing dynamic field references.

Parameters
----------
workspace_id : str
    The workspace ID
payload : PromoteDynamicFieldRequestSchema
    Request body containing SQL hash and field overrides
request : Request
    FastAPI request object
current_user_id : str
    ID of the current authenticated user
db_session : Session
    Database session dependency

Returns
-------
ApiV2Response[PromoteDynamicFieldResponseSchema]
    Response containing updated git files and commit hash
